# Card: the order card the HUD writes on, 1.4 x 3.5 m of cream paper lying on the bench (top at
# 0.07 above it: thinner, the bench's splats poke through). Origin under its centre. Generated by make_env.py. Up Z, front -Y.
new
material new Paper --base-color 0.9294 0.9020 0.7961 --no-slot
add mesh cube --name Card --size 1 --location 0 0 0.035
scale 1.4 3.5 0.07
apply --scale
material assign Paper
mode edit
select face where "normal.z < -0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object
shade flat
export card.glb
